objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-file-transfer-protocol-in-non-common-process-path
objects.description: The following analytic detects FTP connections initiated by processes located in non-standard installation paths on Windows systems. It leverages Sysmon EventCode 3 to identify network connections where the process image path does not match common directories like "Program Files" or "Windows\System32".
